title: Most Volatile Price Period
scenario: Identify the 30-day window for each product where the range (MAX - MIN price) was the highest. Return 'product_id', 'start_date', and 'max_range'.
tableSchema: products (product_id INT, new_price INT, change_date DATE)
hint: Use a self-join with a date range filter.
correctQuery: SELECT p1.product_id, p1.change_date, MAX(p2.new_price) - MIN(p2.new_price) AS max_range FROM products p1 JOIN products p2 ON p1.product_id = p2.product_id AND p2.change_date BETWEEN p1.change_date AND p1.change_date + INTERVAL '30 days' GROUP BY p1.product_id, p1.change_date ORDER BY max_range DESC LIMIT 1;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE products (product_id INT, new_price INT, change_date DATE);
